description: This file defines the MapComparator class, which implements a comparator for maps based on specified keys, supporting ascending and descending order, used for sorting collections of maps.

classes.name: MapComparator
classes.description: A comparator for Map objects that sorts based on a list of keys, supporting ascending and descending order per key.

methods.name: MapComparator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the comparator with a list of keys to sort on.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare MapComparator instances.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two maps based on the specified keys, supporting nulls and order direction.
